title: Working Student - Project management and Construction (all genders)
description:
Q ENERGY is Europe’s 360° green energy company. Together with our more than 500 employees we develop, build, and manage renewable energy assets across the entire value chain of large-scale renewable energy projects – from solar, to onshore wind and offshore wind, to energy storage and hybrid power plants. With a pipeline of more than 11 GW we are among the leading renewable energy companies in Europe. We are always on the lookout for people who want to work with us to empower a sustainable world with green energy.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Working Student** to support the successful delivery of utility-scale renewable energy projects from development through construction and into operational handover.

Working closely with experienced Project Managers, you will gain broad exposure to the entire project lifecycle, supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and commercial management of complex solar PV, battery storage, wind, and other renewable energy infrastructure projects. This role is an excellent opportunity for engineering students who are passionate about the energy transition and aspire to build a career in project management within the renewable energy sector.

Your responsibilities:

You will join our project management team and support the delivery of EPC construction projects. The role is broad. You won’t be expected to cover everything below. Your tasks will depend on your background, interests, and experience, and you’ll grow into more areas over time.

Depending on your focus, you may support us with:

Planning and project controls:

* Developing and implementing project execution plans, schedules, budgets, quality plans, reporting structures, and risk management plans
* Tracking project progress against key milestones and KPIs, identifying risks, issues, delays, and cost impacts, and helping implement mitigation measures
* Monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow, invoice verification, and budget performance
* The invoice payment process and internal approvals

Contracts and commercial management

* Administering the main EPC contract with clients and monitoring compliance with contractual obligations, rights, and responsibilities
* Ensuring contractual requirements are reflected in procurement activities, subcontract agreements, project strategies, and execution plans
* Managing contractual claims, variation orders, and commercial negotiations with clients and subcontractors
* Technical evaluations and the selection of EPC subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and specialized service providers

Delivery and coordination

* Coordinating engineering, procurement, quality assurance, permitting, construction, commissioning, and handover activities
* Ensuring permitting requirements, grid connection requirements, environmental obligations, and technical specifications are incorporated into project planning and execution
* Managing technical interfaces between contractors, suppliers, utilities, clients, and other project stakeholders
* Coordinating project activities to ensure timely delivery and a smooth transition into Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

  
**Requirements**  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in one of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Energy Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Advanced German (at least B2) and good command of English
* Good knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
* Genuine interest in renewable energy and project management
* Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working

  
**Benefits**

We value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* **Our workplace:** Located in a modern and sustainable office building just a few steps from Südkreuz station, making it easily accessible for all employees.
* **IT Equipment:** We’ll set you up with a laptop, monitor, headphones, and, if needed, a company phone.
* **Work-Life Balance:** we value your personal time. Enjoy the flexibility to choose your work hours, so you can prioritize what matters most—whether it’s attending a workout class, handling personal matters, or starting your weekend a little earlier. You’re in control.
* **Mobile Working:** At Q ENERGY we offer a hybrid work model: three days in the office and two days of mobile working. This setup supports in-person teamwork while also allowing for more flexibility and reduced commuting.
* **Spendit Card:** €25 monthly allowance on top of your monthly salary, which can be used for your daily lunch or can be saved up unlimitedly.
* **Public Transport Allowance:** Enjoy a €15 monthly contribution to your BVG ticket—making your commute easier and more affordable!
* **Generous Vacation Policy:** Enjoy a well-deserved break and take 30 vacation days a year plus two special leave days, giving you 32 days total to relax, recharge, and explore!
* **Onboarding:** We provide a detailed onboarding process to ensure you have a smooth and successful start with us, helping you feel supported and prepared from day one.
* **Insurance Coverage:** With accident and life insurance included, we’ve got you covered, giving you peace of mind on and off the job.
* **Corporate Discounts:** Employees get access to exclusive offers and discounts for various brands through our Corporate Benefits program.
* **Corporate Health Management:** Prioritize your well-being with our corporate health management program, including preventive check-ups to keep you at your best!
* **Mutual support:** You’ll thrive in a supportive environment where open communication, teamwork, and knowledge sharing are highly valued. We’re committed to your growth, encouraging your professional and personal development through ongoing support and guidance.

Then we look forward to receiving your application. Please let us know your salary expectations and your earliest possible starting date.

Please note: We do not accept applications by email. Please use the "Apply for this Job" button for your application. Thank you very much!  
  
If you have any questions, please contact our Recruiting team recruiting@qenergy.eu.

Q ENERGY is an internationally operating company - at our company, people from many nations, cultures, and locations work together in partnership and exchange their experiences and values with each other in an open and collegial manner.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Project Management Excellence
description:
**If you really want to make a difference – make it with us**

**Siemens Mobility** is a separately managed company of Siemens AG and has been a leading supplier in the field of mobility for over 160 years. Our core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems and related services. We have always been very innovative in making traveling faster, safer and more comfortable. Today, we need new solutions to new challenges such as climate change and rising populations worldwide. That's what drives us. That's why we shape mobility with passion, always being one step ahead. Through digitalization, we make infrastructures smart and create opportunities that get us from A to B sustainably and seamlessly. Our over 40,000 employees are pioneers in mobility who help to keep the world moving.

  

**What do you contribute?**

In this role, you combine project management, digitalization and Artificial Intelligence. You bring your own ideas and help us develop innovative solutions, identify new opportunities to simplify processes, leverage knowledge and continuously improve the way we manage projects.

* You support Project Management Excellence initiatives, collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders from different countries, functions and businesses.
* Furthermore, you contribute to optimizing project management processes, methods, tools and standards while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* You explore innovative applications of Artificial Intelligence in project management and support the development, testing and implementation of AI-powered solutions, agents and dashboards.
* Additionally, you help automate recurring tasks, improve access to knowledge and promote data-driven decision-making in project management.
* You support the preparation of workshops, project reviews, assessments, and training sessions and support their organizational and content-related execution.
* Moreover, you support the development of training concepts and knowledge-sharing resources for our international Project Management community and promote the exchange of best practices.
* You coordinate cross-country initiatives, follow up on agreed action items, and contribute your own ideas to ensure sustainable improvements.

  

**What do you bring along?**

* You are currently studying Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Engineering, Project Management, Business Informatics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or a comparable field.
* You are passionate about project management and Project Management Excellence and ideally have gained initial practical experience in project management, a PMO or a project-oriented environment.
* Furthermore, you are enthusiastic about Artificial Intelligence and digitalization and have gained initial hands-on experience with generative AI applications such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Ideally, you have basic knowledge of Power BI and other digitalization tools and enjoy helping us put innovative solutions into practice.
* Additionally, you are confident in using Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint and Excel, and can present complex information in a clear and compelling way.
* Moreover, you communicate confidently with different stakeholders, enjoy working in international teams and have very good English skills as well as basic German language skills.

  

**What do we offer you?**

Inclusion & Diversity

At Siemens Mobility, we're committed to fighting injustice and inequality. At our company, you will find an environment where you can be yourself and belong.

Purpose

We are pioneers in mobility. At Siemens Mobility, you will actively contribute to the transformation of transportation and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transportation solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.

Mobile working /Remote working

With us, you will have the opportunity to work hybrid. This means that you can work remotely to a considerable extent. We have officially regulated this through a company agreement.

Attractive conditions

With us you will receive an attractive salary. You start with about 15€ per hour and from the 7th month on about 19€.

You can find an overview of our benefits here.

  

**How do you get in touch with us?**

**www.siemens.de/mobility**  
if you would like to find out more about Siemens Mobility before applying.  
**www.siemens.com/global/en/company/jobs/faq.html**  
if you would like to obtain more information about the application process.  
**+49 (9131) 17 5243-0**  
if you would like to clarify further questions about the position via our applicant hotline.
  
**www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs**  
if you would like more information about jobs and careers at Siemens.

As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities.

The contact person handling this job ad is Ms. Christin Hitz.

**Working Student (m/f/d) - IT Security Operations**
====================================================

**Hybrid | Part time | Student (not yet graduated)**

**Stronger Grids. Secure Future.**  
Trench Group is a global technology leader for high-voltage grid components and systems, present in nearly every power transmission grid worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, with more than 100 years of engineering expertise, Trench Group designs and manufactures high-voltage components that address the core challenges of modern power infrastructure – connecting grids, measuring their performance and ensuring reliability. As electricity demand rises and power grids transform worldwide, Trench Group is a key enabler of the infrastructure the world needs. The company operates 11 factories across 8 countries on 4 continents and employs more than 3,000 people – with plans to grow to 4,000 by 2030.

**Your Mission**
  
As our new Working Student in IT Security Operations, you’ll join our Information & Cyber Security team, which protects Trench Group against real-world threats. Your mission: help keep our people, devices and systems running securely, whether that’s supporting colleagues with security tools, triaging a suspicious email or turning raw data into a clear report.

**Your Tasks:**
---------------

* **Endpoint & Microsoft 365 Support:** Supporting device onboarding, access requests and day-to-day administration tasks
* **Security Tool User Support:** Helping colleagues with issues around DLP and email-security add-ins, MFA and authenticator apps, and device compliance
* **Asset & Inventory Management:** Keeping device, software and tool inventories accurate and up to date
* **Security Operations Support:** Triaging user-reported phishing and suspicious emails, and handling alerts under the guidance of the team
* **Security Tooling:** Helping operate and fine-tune DLP policies, email security, and antivirus configurations
* **Reporting & KPIs**: Preparing security reports and dashboards, e.g. vulnerability status, policy compliance and awareness campaign results
* **Documentation:** Maintaining runbooks and process descriptions
* **Security Awareness:** Supporting phishing simulations, training content and internal security communications
* **Vulnerability Management:** Coordinating remediation with IT and site teams, and tracking findings to closure
* **Automation:** Contributing scripts (PowerShell, KL, Python) that reduce manual work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* **Education:** Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Information Security, Business Informatics or a related degree programme, with at least 12 months of student status remaining
* **Experience:** Initial practical experience in IT and security operations support, helpdesk or system administration
* **Technical Skills:** Solid understanding of Windows, MS Azure cloud and Microsoft 365 and networking fundamentals
* **Working Style**: Structured, independent and reliable, with a high degree of discretion in handling confidential information
* **Language Skills:** Fluent English; German is an advantage
* **Security Interest (preferred)**: Interest in cyber security, e.g. coursework, CTFs, certifications or personal projects
* **AI Experience (preferred):** Hands-on experience using AI tools or building AI-assisted workflows, e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering or automation agents

**We offer:**
-------------

* **Growth with Purpose:** Join a globally growing energy company with a vision and a bright future in the energy transition
* **Strong Teams, Big Energy:** Work in highly professional, international teams defined by respect, appreciation, and a d drive to shape the future of energy
* **Fair Rewards:** Competitive pay, monthly vouchers for shopping, well‑being, or personal development, plus subsidized lunch and membership in a corporate benefits program
    
  **Personal & Professional Development:** Learn and grow in an international environment with hands‑on experience and continuous development opportunities
* **Modern Working Environment:** A modern way of working, 30 days’ vacation, and a tariff agreement combined with contemporary offices, height‑adjustable desks, free fruit & coffee, and regular team events

title: Student assistant (m/f/d) for the project CC-IDI (Community-Cooperative Driven Island Decarbonization Initiative)
description:
**Short description**
---------------------

RLI is a non-profit research institute in Berlin. In the project CC-IDI (Oct 2026 Sep 2029), funded by the International Climate Initiative (IKI), we support island communities on Romblon, Sibuyan and Corcuera (Philippines) in planning their climate-neutral energy supply, together with our Philippine partners. You support the project team in Berlin with project management, documentation, communication and data analysis.

**Your tasks**
--------------

* Research and preparation of information on the project islands (local climate action plans, power supply, stakeholders)
* Support in project management: to-do lists, scheduling, meeting minutes, coordination with the Philippine partners
* Support in project documentation and reporting, including filing of receipts
* Preparation of workshops, travel and stakeholder meetings
* Communication support: presentations, website content, newsletter, social media
* Data evaluation and overviews (electricity demand, costs, participation processes)

**Your profile**
----------------

* Candidates must be enrolled at a university, preferably in energy or environmental sciences, geography, economics, politics, development cooperation or a related relevant field
* Residence and right of abode in Germany is required
* Very good English language skills are required (C1), good German language skills
* Confident use of Office applications and spreadsheets
* Interest in the energy transition, climate action and working with local communities
* Knowledge of the Philippines, international project experience or Tagalog is a plus
* Experience with project tools, graphics or presentations is a plus
* Identification with the RLI Values
* We require an independent, systematic, and meticulous approach to work, as well as the ability to communicate and document work results

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Friendly and open working atmosphere in a young, interdisciplinary team (around 85 people currently work at RLI, including around 25 students)
* A transparent and participative corporate culture
* Location on the Adlershof science campus with excellent public transport connections
* Possibility of mobile working / flexible working hours without core hours and flexible working locations within Germany by arrangement
* Vacation days according to statutory vacation entitlement
* RLI Christmas party / end-of-year party - a highlight for all employees
* Internal training opportunities and professional support / further development
* Regular RLI days at Tempelhofer Feld or other locations with a wide range of workshops
* Participation in the Adlershof health network - free impulses as part of company health management

**General condition**
---------------------

* Start of work on 01.01.2027 or by arrangement
* Between 40 and 60 hours per month possible by arrangement
* Remuneration with a gross hourly rate of €15.50 per hour
* If applicable, a thesis may be written as part of this position within the project contextif you are interested, please mention this in your application

**Are you interested in this position?****Then upload your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, certificates, etc.) in a PDF file via the Apply button.****We look forward to receiving your application!**

###### **Tätigkeitsbereich**

Forschung und Entwicklung

###### **Karrierestufe**

Studium/Praktikum/Ausbildung

###### **Standorte**

Rudower Chaussee 12, 12489 Berlin, Deutschland
  
Mobiles Arbeiten

### **Unser Institut**

Das Reiner Lemoine Institut ist ein unabhängiges, gemeinnütziges Forschungsinstitut, das sich für eine Zukunft mit 100 % Erneuerbaren Energien einsetzt. Unsere drei Forschungsbereiche sind Transformation von Energiesystemen, Mobilität mit Erneuerbaren Energien und Off-Grid Systems.

### **Our institute**

The Reiner Lemoine Institute is an independent, non-profit research institute that is committed to a future with 100% renewable energy. Our three research areas are the Transformation of Energy Systems, Mobility with Renewable Energies and Off-Grid Systems.
  
  
For further questions about applications please contact Patricia Kneiert.

### **Unsere Werte und Ziele am RLI**

Wir haben unsere Werte und Ziele, auf die wir täglich hinarbeiten, gemeinsam entwickelt und in einem Grundsatzdokument zusammengefasst: das Ergebnis ist unsere RLI Charta. Dieses Dokument spiegelt unsere Philosophie wider und zeigt, was uns bei der täglichen Arbeit und im gemeinsamen Miteinander wichtig ist.
  
  
Das RLI hat ebenfalls die Charta der Vielfalt unterzeichnet, weil wir neben unserem Engagement für die Energiewende auch aktiv für die Gleichwertigkeit aller Menschen eintreten. Wir begrüßen und schätzen Vielfalt am RLI.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Project Management and Operations Excellence
description:
**Location:** BLN H

**Mode of Employment:** Part-time / Fixed Term

**A Snapshot of Your Day**

Join our dynamic Parts and Repair department at Siemens Energy in Germany as a Working Student, where you will play a vital role in supporting project management initiatives within Gas Services. You will actively engage in tracking milestones, preparing status reports, and coordinating meetings, ensuring seamless communication among stakeholders. Imagine contributing to quality audits and operational excellence projects while enhancing your skills in a collaborative environment. Your efforts will directly support our mission of continuous improvement and operational efficiency, making a real impact on our team and the broader organization.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Support project management activities by preparing presentations, tracking project progress, and reporting updates
* Actively participate in key initiatives, contributing your insights and ideas to drive success
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items and minutes for effective follow-up
* Assist in monitoring project milestones, tracking deliverables, and preparing updates for stakeholders
* Support the preparation and compilation of documentation for upcoming internal Quality Audits
* Take ownership of smaller improvement projects within the Parts and Repair business area, contributing to process optimization efforts

**What You Bring**

* Enrolled student in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a related field
* Initial experience in project management, operations, and quality management, gained through internships or university projects
* Availability for up to 20 hours per week, maintaining working student status in Germany
* Strong organizational skills and a solid foundation in project management methodologies
* Proficiency in English and intermediate to advanced German
* Interest in digitalization, AI, and process automation, with a good understanding of quality management principles

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. title: Student assistant (f/m/d) for the project CC-IDI (Community-Cooperative Driven Island Decarbonization Initiative)
description:
**Short description**
---------------------

RLI is a non-profit research institute in Berlin. In the project CC-IDI (from Oct 2026 till Sep 2029), funded by the International Climate Initiative (IKI), we support island communities on Romblon, Sibuyan and Corcuera (Philippines) in planning their climate-neutral energy supply, together with our Philippine partners. You support the project team in Berlin with project management, documentation, communication and data analysis.

**Your tasks**
--------------

* Research and preparation of information on the project islands (local climate action plans, power supply, stakeholders)
* Support in project management: to-do lists, scheduling, meeting minutes, coordination with the Philippine partners
* Support in project documentation and reporting, including filing of receipts
* Preparation of workshops, travel and stakeholder meetings
* Communication support: presentations, website content, newsletter, social media
* Data evaluation and overviews (electricity demand, costs, participation processes)

**Your profile**
----------------

* Candidates must be enrolled at a university, preferably in energy or environmental sciences, geography, economics, politics, development cooperation or a related relevant field
* Residence and right of abode in Germany is required
* Very good English language skills are required (C1), good German language skills
* Confident use of Office applications and spreadsheets
* Interest in the energy transition, climate action and working with local communities
* Knowledge of the Philippines, international project experience or Tagalog is a plus
* Experience with project tools, graphics or presentations is a plus
* Identification with the RLI Values
* We require an independent, systematic, and meticulous approach to work, as well as the ability to communicate and document work results

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Friendly and open working atmosphere in a young, interdisciplinary team (around 85 people currently work at RLI, including around 25 students)
* A transparent and participative corporate culture
* Location on the Adlershof science campus with excellent public transport connections
* Possibility of mobile working / flexible working hours without core hours and flexible working locations within Germany by arrangement
* Vacation days according to statutory vacation entitlement
* RLI Christmas party / end-of-year party - a highlight for all employees
* Internal training opportunities and professional support / further development
* Regular RLI days at Tempelhofer Feld or other locations with a wide range of workshops
* Participation in the Adlershof health network - free impulses as part of company health management

**General condition**
---------------------

* Start of work on 01.01.2027 or by arrangement
* Between 40 and 60 hours per month possible by arrangement
* Remuneration with a gross hourly rate of €15.50 per hour
* If applicable, a thesis may be written as part of this position within the project contextif you are interested, please mention this in your application

**Are you interested in this position?****Then upload your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, certificates, etc.) in a PDF file via the Apply button.****We look forward to receiving your application!**

###### **Tätigkeitsbereich**

Forschung und Entwicklung

###### **Karrierestufe**

Studium/Praktikum/Ausbildung

###### **Standorte**

Rudower Chaussee 12, 12489 Berlin, Deutschland
  
Mobiles Arbeiten

### **Unser Institut**

Das Reiner Lemoine Institut ist ein unabhängiges, gemeinnütziges Forschungsinstitut, das sich für eine Zukunft mit 100 % Erneuerbaren Energien einsetzt. Unsere drei Forschungsbereiche sind Transformation von Energiesystemen, Mobilität mit Erneuerbaren Energien und Off-Grid Systems.

### **Our institute**

The Reiner Lemoine Institute is an independent, non-profit research institute that is committed to a future with 100% renewable energy. Our three research areas are the Transformation of Energy Systems, Mobility with Renewable Energies and Off-Grid Systems.
  
  
For further questions about applications please contact Patricia Kneiert.

### **Unsere Werte und Ziele am RLI**

Wir haben unsere Werte und Ziele, auf die wir täglich hinarbeiten, gemeinsam entwickelt und in einem Grundsatzdokument zusammengefasst: das Ergebnis ist unsere RLI Charta. Dieses Dokument spiegelt unsere Philosophie wider und zeigt, was uns bei der täglichen Arbeit und im gemeinsamen Miteinander wichtig ist.
  
  
Das RLI hat ebenfalls die Charta der Vielfalt unterzeichnet, weil wir neben unserem Engagement für die Energiewende auch aktiv für die Gleichwertigkeit aller Menschen eintreten. Wir begrüßen und schätzen Vielfalt am RLI.

description:
* Cabka Group GmbH

* Working student

Cabka develops clever and transformative solutions for shipping goods around the world. We take plastic waste and transform it into reusable transport packaging. This is how we turn the used into the useful. Transformation is our power because we know that while resources are limited, possibilities are endless. Together with our customers, we transform entire supply chains and beyond, combining technology, innovation, and sustainability. To us, success means creating solutions that are optimal for our clients and for the planet. In Cabka we believe that every transformation starts with a group of passionate, dedicated, and innovative people. It is for them that we live a culture of inclusion, respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values RESPECT, PASSION, CREATIVITY, ACCOUNTABILITY.

**Turning sustainability ambitions into measurable progress starts with the right data. As our Working Student Sustainability Reporting, you will help us turn data into transparency and support the progress of our sustainability initiatives.**

### **Working Student Sustainability Reporting (f/m/d)**

based in Berlin

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Sustainability Reporting:** Support regular internal and external reporting on sustainability KPIs and contribute to the preparation of sustainability-related information.
* **Data Collection & Analysis:** Collect and analyze data for sustainability programs and support ad-hoc analyses of sustainability developments relevant to Cabka.
* **Sustainability Systems:** Maintain systems used to measure and track the progress of sustainability initiatives.
* **Cross-Functional Support:** Provide sustainability-related information to colleagues across different entities and support collaboration on sustainability topics.
* **Administrative Support:** Take on administrative tasks related to the team's sustainability activities.

**Your profile**
----------------

* **Studies:** Currently enrolled at a German university, ideally in Business or Public Administration, Environmental Planning, Engineering or a related field, preferably at Master’s level with a completed Bachelor’s degree.
* **Sustainability Knowledge:** High interest in sustainability reporting in an international corporate environment; previous experience with ESRS, sustainability reporting, data analysis or regulatory publications is beneficial.
* **Analytical & Project Skills:** Advanced analytical skills, an outcome-oriented approach and good project management capabilities.Working Style: Independent, self-motivated and structured, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Strong communication skills, persistence and intercultural competence.
* **Languages:** Confident communication skills in both German and English; additional languages are a plus.
* **Systems:** Proficient in MS 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Purpose & Impact:** Get involved in a variety of sustainability projects and work on topics that connect sustainability with our business.
* **Learning & Development:** Take responsibility from the start, develop your skills and gain valuable practical experience alongside your studies.
* **International Team:** Work in a multicultural team and collaborate with colleagues across different functions and countries.
* **Room for Ideas:** Bring your own perspective and ideas and help shape how we approach sustainability topics.
* **Modern Workplace:** Enjoy our modern office right on Kurfürstendamm in the heart of Berlin, including our own barista.
* **Benefits:** Attractive compensation, company events and fresh fruit in the office.

We embrace Diversity and Inclusion and are committed to providing equal opportunities to all of our applicants as well as our employees – regardless of race, gender, age, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation and gender identity, disability, cultural, ethnic or national origins. Are you an innovative out-of-the-box thinker with a passion for changing the world to the better tomorrow? **Then we are looking forward to your application!** Please use our online application form to apply.

Als Werkstudent Contract, Risk, IT Asset & Vendor Management (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Teams dabei, das Zusammenspiel von Geschäftspartnern, Verträgen, Technologie und Daten zu verbessern. Je nach Interesse und Projektbedarf bringst du dich in unterschiedliche Themen ein und entwickelst dein eigenes fachliches Profil.

Dabei lernst du, AI-Tools verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen und Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit zu prüfen.

* **Digitale Transformation:** Du unterstützt bei der Analyse und Optimierung von Prozessen und Assetmanagementsystemen sowie bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen für Einkauf, Vertrags-, und Risikomanagement.
* **Analyse & Insights:** Du recherchierst und analysierst Daten zu Geschäftspartnern, Verträgen, Software, Cloud-Nutzung und Kosten. Dabei hilfst du, Transparenz zu schaffen, Auffälligkeiten zu erkennen und Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

* **Interesse an digitaler Transformation** sowie am Zusammenspiel von Business, Technologie und Risiko. Erste praktische Erfahrungen, beispielsweise durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder Hochschulprojekte in den Bereichen Beratung, Datenanalyse, Einkauf, Vertrags- oder Risikomanagement, sind von Vorteil
* **Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office**, insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint, sowie Interesse an datengetriebenen Fragestellungen. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Artificial Intelligence oder AI-gestützten Tools sind willkommen
* **Strukturierte Arbeitsweise**, analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig und gemeinsam im Team zu bearbeiten und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln
* **Deutsch und Englisch** sehr gut in Wort und Schrift sowie Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Reisen

* **Echte Verantwortung** für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest
* **Persönliche:r Mentor:in** in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt

* **Work-Life-Balance** in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet
* **Bereichsübergreifendes Networking** im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch
* **Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume** und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

You will help provision and hand over VS-TOP laptops for secure mobile working. You will also support our Berlin team with guided tours and hands-on infrastructure tasks, including installing and configuring new hardware, adapting existing systems, and documenting technical changes.

**What you’ll bring**

You're a student ready to contribute alongside your studies. You're curious, adapt quickly, and stay resilient as priorities evolve. You think creatively, communicate clearly, and collaborate well across teams. You're building your foundations in business and AI — and you take initiative to apply them. You bring emotional intelligence and cultural awareness to every interaction.

You are studying computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field and bring practical programming experience with Python. You are familiar with Linux, Git, Docker, and SQL databases. Through university or personal projects, you have gained initial experience in web security, vulnerability analysis, or capture-the-flag competitions. You have a basic understanding of information security management and frameworks such as BSI IT-Grundschutz and ISO 27001. Experience with machine learning, large language models, or building data pipelines for security analysis and alert enrichment is a plus. title: Card Operations Working Student
description:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.

Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.

#### **Why join Solaris?**

* We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
* We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
* Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
* + ️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.

#### **Your Role**

* Provide 2nd level support by processing tickets of all cards related issues and process Card Returns.
* Help achieve the team’s OKRs

#### **We'd love to see**

Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.

* You are currently a university student of a relevant discipline - Economic, Maths, Finance, Data Science etc.
* Google suite and MS office. SQL is a plus.
* You manage yourself and prioritize your tasks effectively.
* Fluent command of English. German language skills at minimum B1.
* Energetic and hands-on team player with excellent communication skills, who leverages empathy and persuasion.
* Creative and solutions-oriented, able to tackle complex challenges with practical problem-solving and an adaptable mindset.
* Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.

#### **Benefits**

* Transparent framework to support your career goals
* Lunch reimbursement
* Flexible working model

  

*While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.*

At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.

  

Information on data processing:

DE: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_de  
EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_en

€17 - €17 EUR

Working closely with our team, you will develop and test AI-powered solutions, improve digital workflows, and gain hands-on experience with modern technologies. What makes this role special: You won't be working in traditional customer support. Instead, you'll help shape what customer service looks like in the future. description:
**Company Description**

Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.  
  
Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.

Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.  
  
Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).

* Familiarity with project and documentation management tools is a plus

* All internships are worth the same with us: we also remunerate mandatory internships
* Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing sessions
* Work productively with the latest hardware and tools
* Free subscription to the PRIME+ Broker

title: Corporate Human Resources Partner Working Student (12 Months) - 2027
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

See your impact in motion | Discover careers at our Data Centers
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Data Centers power the technology
  
people rely on every day, from streaming services and mobile apps to
  
cloud computing, generative AI, and online shopping. They’re the
  
foundation that enables hospitals, financial institutions, governments,
  
and businesses around the world to deliver the services people depend
  
on, when they need them.  
  
In these roles, you’ll work on the real-world infrastructure that keeps
  
technology running securely, reliably, and at global scale. You’ll solve
  
problems, collaborate across teams, and use advanced tools to support
  
systems that millions of people interact with every day.  
  
This is where your work connects to something bigger, moving beyond
  
theory into impact you can see, feel, and be part of, all while helping
  
build the future of Amazon Web Services.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage an end-to-end project with one of Amazon's HR teams in EMEA over a 12-week period

  

* Collaborate with senior management and business partners, as well as cross-functional HR support teams, to gain a 360-degree view of Amazon's approach to human resources

  

* Learn and contribute to Amazon's approach to hiring and developing top talent

  

* Support people operations and help preserve Amazon's peculiar culture in the way we attract, hire, and develop talented people

  

* Work cross-functionally across areas such as compensation, onboarding, training and development, talent acquisition, and international HR

  

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement creative solutions across HR teams worldwide

  

* Deliver a continuously improving employee experience by thinking broadly and working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

  

* Gain insight into managerial strategy and concepts, understanding everything that goes on behind the scenes to ensure teams have what they need to develop and retain a high-powered workforce

  
A day in the life  
No two days are the same as a Working Student at Amazon. Depending on your team, you could be diving into your project work — whether that involves analyzing compensation data, supporting an onboarding improvement initiative, or collaborating with the talent acquisition team on hiring strategies. You will participate in cross-functional meetings with HR colleagues, including international HR teams, working through process improvements that impact teams worldwide. You will also have the opportunity to network with other interns and attend learning sessions with senior HR leaders who share insights on Amazon's peculiar culture and leadership principles.
  
  
Throughout, you will balance project-focused deep dives with broad exposure to HR operations, from training and development programs to employee experience initiatives. Every day brings hands-on experience in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your contributions directly support Amazon's ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.
  
  
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
* Currently in your penultimate year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in HR, HR Management, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Psychology, Social Sciences, Law or a related field (Humanities focused), or a similar discipline
* Eligible to complete a working student placement for up to 12 months

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
* Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication with a keen focus on delivering business results.
* Demonstrated track record in using data and metrics to make decisions and build scalable solutions.
* Ability to influence across all levels of an organization.
* Ability to act strategically and make decisions under ambiguity.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations
description:
**Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:**  
  
**Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations**

Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!

Die **Arsipa Gruppe** ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

**Deine Aufgaben:**

**Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration**

* Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung.
* Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme.
* Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher.
* Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

**Finance Transformation & Standardisierung**

* Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg.
* Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter.
* Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
* Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

**Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement**

* Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.
* Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.
* Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte.
* Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder.

**Deine Startvoraussetzungen:**

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.
* Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus.
* Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

**Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:**

* Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil.
* Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert.
* Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus.
* Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern.

**Unsere Benefits:**

* **Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld:** 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

* **Starke Teamkultur:** Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.
* **Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business:** Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.
* **Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform:** Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.
* **Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe:** Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

**Unser Bewerbungsprozess:**

* **Kurzes Telefonat** mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe.
* **Interview** mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner\*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.
* **Persönliches Kennenlernen** mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner\*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.

Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!  
Du erreichst das Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa-Gruppe unter **talent@arsipa.de****.**

**Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise bei der Arsipa Gruppe - Wir freuen uns auf Dich!**

description:
Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. The Job:
  
As a Working Student Legal & Privacy, you will get hands-on experience of how an in-house legal function supports one of Germany’s leading online marketplaces. As part of our Legal & Privacy team, you will work on topics ranging from contracts and data protection to platform regulation while helping us continuously improve how we work. You will collaborate with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen and explore how AI can make legal work smarter and more efficient. This is a hybrid role, our current office is in Berlin-Charlottenburg and we will be moving to the Ostbahnhof area in Q1 2027.

  

**Who You Are:**

* You are currently studying Law, Business Law, Legal Management, or a related subject at a university in Germany.
* You are interested in legal topics such as contracts, data protection, and platform regulation and curious about how legal teams support a digital business.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Help improve legal templates, internal guidance, and operational processes, including exploring and testing AI-supported workflows.
* Support the team with a variety of legal and operational projects while collaborating with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen.

### **About Yepoda**

**Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.**

Our mission is to bring **Clean K-Beauty Innovations**,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based **in the heart of Berlin**. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified **B Corp**, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for **Working Students** to join our **Performance Marketing** team and get real, hands-on experience running paid campaigns across channels like Google, Meta, TikTok, and Youtube. You will support the team in setting up, monitoring, and optimising campaigns, work with live data and budgets from day one, and build practical skills in one of the most in-demand areas of e-commerce marketing.

* **Campaign Support:** Assist in the setup, monitoring, and optimisation of marketing campaigns across our paid channels (Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)

* **Ideas & Concepts:** Contribute creative ideas and new concepts to improve campaign effectiveness, from fresh ad angles to social media trends worth testing

* You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Media Management, Business, Economics, or a related field
* You have a strong interest in performance or online marketing, whether that shows up through your coursework, a previous internship or working student role, or your own projects
* You have strong analytical skills, great attention to detail, and enjoy turning campaign data into insights
* You communicate clearly and in a structured way, and bring a hands-on attitude and a high level of initiative
* You have a passion for beauty topics and a keen interest in social media trends (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
* You are confident with Excel or Google Sheets; first experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or TikTok Ads Manager is a bonus, and we're happy to bring the right person up to speed

* **Dynamic Environment:** The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
* **Accelerate Your Career:** Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

* **Hybrid Working:** We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
* **We Value Diversity:** We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
* **Employee Discounts:** You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
* **Unique Add Ons:** A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Working Student - Learning & Development
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

At BCG, the continuous personal and professional development of our people is a top priority. As a **Working Student in the Learning & Development (L&D) team**, you’ll support the delivery of high-quality training experiences across Central Europe. You’ll work alongside an experienced and collaborative team to help ensure our trainings run smoothly — both behind the scenes and occasionally on site. From logistics coordination to data and overall team support, your contribution will help shape the learning journey.

* Assist with the preparation, conduction, and follow-up of training programs for our consulting and business services teams
* Support the CE L&D team in daily delivery excellence and occasionally more project-related work e.g., our AI upskilling initiatives
* Help creating and updating participant lists, preparing training materials, and ensuring the training setup is ready
* Maintain training data in internal systems e.g., team calendar and training database
* Help manage and track training feedback and assist with basic analysis
* Take care of training equipment, ensuring everything is in working condition
* Occasionally support trainings on site e.g., room setup, welcoming trainers/participants, trainer equipment, etc.

**You’re good at**

* You bring strong organizational and administrative skills and a service-oriented mindset with curiosity for AI and new ways of working
* You work reliably, with attention to detail, and can adapt when plans change
* You’re a team player who enjoys working with people across different locations
* You have a hands-on mentality and are happy to step in wherever support is needed
* Ideally, you have first experience in related fields and event coordination

You can work up to 20 hours/week during your semesters and up to 40 hours/week during your vacation time. The role offers enough flexibility to combine personal, academic and professional life, with an expected workload of approximately two working days per week. This is a temporary role from min. 12 to max. 24 months. You need to be an enrolled university student in Germany.

What You'll Bring

* You are enrolled at a (vocational) college or university.
* You’ve already completed internships or otherwise acquired practical work experience in the field of HR.
* You’re able to work proficiently with the software in the MS Office package and have a natural aptitude for latest tools and learning trends
* Very good written and spoken German and English language skills complete your profile.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be part of the Central Europe Learning & Development team, where collaboration, mutual respect, and trust shape how we work together.

You’ll work closely with our European and Global Learning & Development teams as well as local HR colleagues, gaining valuable insights into different areas of Learning & Development and HR.

You’ll report to the Central Europe Learning & Development Manager, who will support you throughout your onboarding and professional development at BCG.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Working Student Strategic Purchasing (m/f/d)
description:
**Build a career powered by innovations that matter!** At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

This position is part of **Novanta’s Advanced Surgery (AS) business unit** , a leader in the field of minimally invasive surgery. Our mission is to develop innovative medical devices and accessories that enable surgeons to perform procedures through smaller incisions, helping improve patient outcomes and recovery times.

  

Our portfolio includes advanced camera systems, insufflators, medical pumps, and specialized tubing solutions that support both diagnosis and treatment. By expanding body cavities and facilitating access during surgery, our technologies help transform complex procedures into less invasive interventions. Working closely with customers, physicians, and technical experts, we continuously strive to advance surgical innovation and improve healthcare worldwide.

**Job Summary**

  

As a **Working Student Strategic Purchasing** , you will support our team of Strategic Buyers (Category Leaders) in managing supplier relationships, analyzing sourcing markets, and driving procurement initiatives. You will take ownership of a spend category and/or contribute to key strategic projects within one of our business segments, gaining valuable hands-on experience in a global and innovative environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

* Analyze sourcing markets and build expertise in supplier landscapes and industry trends.
* Support the development and execution of sourcing strategies that foster innovation, optimize costs, and strengthen supplier partnerships.
* Assist in preparing for and participating in supplier negotiations.
* Support indirect purchasing activities and help manage procurement-related expenses through our global expense management tools.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across the organization.
* Work closely with R&D and other stakeholders to identify and commercialize new technologies, materials, and supplier opportunities.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external partners.
* Learn and apply strategic procurement best practices and tools, including purchase-to-pay processes, logistics concepts, and value stream mapping.
Support additional tasks and projects as assigned by the manager.  

  

**Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies**

  
Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field, or possess equivalent knowledge and experience.  

  

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel; experience with Power BI is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a proactive mindset.
* Ability to quickly learn new systems, work independently, and contribute effectively as part of a team.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.  

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Werkstudent:in KI-Assistent im HR-Bereich (w/m/d) für mindestens 12 Monate für die Deutsche Bahn AG am Standort Berlin.

Bei dieser Stelle besteht die Möglichkeit des hybriden Arbeitens. In Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft kannst du sowohl am festgelegten Bürostandort, als auch mobil an einem Ort deiner Wahl innerhalb Deutschlands tätig sein.

### **Deine Aufgaben:**

* Du unterstützt das Projektteam „Mein Assistent" bei der fachlichen Analyse, Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung HR-relevanter Inhalte für den Einsatz eines KI-Assistenten
* Dabei wirkst du bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation projektbezogener Abstimmungen, Interviews und Arbeitsergebnisse zur bedarfsgerechten Weiterentwicklung des KI-Assistenten mit

* Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Bewertung und Aufbereitung redaktioneller Anpassungsbedarfe im Wissensmanagement, insbesondere zur Sicherstellung der Auffindbarkeit, Aktualität und Qualität relevanter Inhalte

* Du befindest dich im fortgeschrittenen Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Personalmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Personal oder Organisation oder KI Themen

* Zudem arbeitest du strukturiert und sorgfältig und bringst gute Kenntnisse in den gängigen Office-Anwendungen mit

title: Working Student Sustainability Reporting (f/m/d)
description: Cabka develops clever and transformative solutions for shipping goods around the world. We take plastic waste and transform it into reusable transport packaging. This is how we turn the used into the useful. Transformation is our power because we know that while resources are limited, possibilities are endless. Together with our customers, we transform entire supply chains and beyond, combining technology, innovation, and sustainability. To us, success means creating solutions that are optimal for our clients and for the planet. In Cabka we believe that every transformation starts with a group of passionate, dedicated, and innovative people. It is for them that we live a culture of inclusion, respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values RESPECT, PASSION, CREATIVITY, ACCOUNTABILITY. Turning sustainability ambitions into measurable progress starts with the right data. As our Working Student Sustainability Reporting, you will help us turn data into transparency and support the progress of our sustainability initiatives. Working Student Sustainability Reporting (f/m/d) based in Berlin Your responsibilities Sustainability Reporting: Support regular internal and external reporting on sustainability KPIs and contribute to the preparation of sustainability-related information. Data Collection & Analysis: Collect and analyze data for sustainability programs and support ad-hoc analyses of sustainability developments relevant to Cabka. Sustainability Systems: Maintain systems used to measure and track the progress of sustainability initiatives. Cross-Functional Support: Provide sustainability-related information to colleagues across different entities and support collaboration on sustainability topics. Administrative Support: Take on administrative tasks related to the team's sustainability activities. Your profile Studies: Currently enrolled at a German university, ideally in Business or Public Administration, Environmental Planning, Engineering or a related field, preferably at Master’s level with a completed Bachelor’s degree. Sustainability Knowledge: High interest in sustainability reporting in an international corporate environment; previous experience with ESRS, sustainability reporting, data analysis or regulatory publications is beneficial. Analytical & Project Skills: Advanced analytical skills, an outcome-oriented approach and good project management capabilities.Working Style: Independent, self-motivated and structured, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills, persistence and intercultural competence. Languages: Confident communication skills in both German and English; additional languages are a plus. Systems: Proficient in MS 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Data, Controlling & KPI-Reporting
description: Einarbeitung (Monat 1–2): Du lernst unsere Datenquellen, KPIs und bestehenden Auswertungen kennen und erstellst die Reports zunächst gemeinsam mit unserem Team, dann zunehmend selbstständig. Deine Aufgaben Tägliches KPI-Reporting: Du stellst dem Head of KAM jeden Tag alle benötigten Auswertungen bereit: aktuell, korrekt und auf den Punkt. Kennzahlen im Blick: Du verfolgst die wichtigsten KPIs und vergleichst sie mit den Vorwochen und dem Durchschnitt. Proaktive Abweichungsanalyse: Weichen Zahlen ab, meldest Du das von Dir aus und ordnest ein, was dahintersteckt. Ursachen finden, Handlungsbedarf erkennen: Du analysierst die Gründe und zeigst auf, bei welchen Teammitgliedern Unterstützung oder Handlungsbedarf besteht. Reports weiterentwickeln & automatisieren: Du optimierst bestehende Auswertungen und automatisierst wiederkehrende Reports, wo es sinnvoll ist. Ad-hoc-Analysen: Du übernimmst kurzfristige Analysen für das Key Account Management. Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschriebener Student, z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach. Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und gehst sicher mit MS Excel oder Google Sheets um. Plus, aber kein Muss: Erste Erfahrung mit SQL, BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau oder im Controlling. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert, auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss. Du kommunizierst klar und traust Dich, Auffälligkeiten direkt anzusprechen, auch gegenüber Führungskräften. Du kannst 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten, verteilt auf alle Wochentage (Mo–Fr), da das Reporting täglich anfällt. Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin Mitte. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch (mindestens C1), da Du täglich Auswertungen mit dem Head of KAM besprichst und Auffälligkeiten klar kommunizierst. C2 ist ein Plus. Benefits Echte Verantwortung – Du hast einen direkten Draht zum Head of Key Account Management, und Deine Analysen zählen jeden Tag. Praxiswissen für Studium und Karriere – Du sammelst Erfahrung in Controlling, KPI-Reporting und Datenanalyse. Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Innerhalb des Tages stimmst Du Deine Arbeitszeiten auf Deine Vorlesungen ab. In der Prüfungsphase finden wir gemeinsam eine Lösung. Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte – Zentral gelegen, mit bester Anbindung und freundlicher Atmosphäre. Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg. Innovative Tools – Slack, Zoom & CRM-Systeme, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient machen. Events & Teambuilding – Ob Fußball, Volleyball oder After-Work: Bei uns kommt der Spaß nicht zu kurz. Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck. FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier. Office Dogs welcome – Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns herzlich willkommen. Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht, ein paar Sätze, warum Dich die Stelle reizt, freuen uns aber. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Pflegia ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Bei uns zählt nicht, woher Du kommst, sondern wohin Du gemeinsam mit uns willst.

title: Student Assistant (all genders) - Chair of Data Sience
description:
**ESCP Business School Berlin** is a state-recognised university and one of the leading business schools in Europe. Our **Chair of Data Science** is looking for a

**Student Assistant (all genders)**
===================================

from asap | 10 hours per week | in Berlin or Remote | 14.32 €/hour | Master's thesis possible

**Your Responsibilities**

Why do people so often choose a smaller reward now over a larger one later – and how much can this be shaped? Working at the intersection of decision making and data science, you will:

* Map research on time preferences in a structured literature review
* Analyse experimental choice data, from classic discounting models to machine learning
* Potentially explore complementary real-world data, e.g. from social media, using NLP and other data-science methods
* Contribute to writing the scientific paper and work with our international collaborators

You will also assist with the preparation of teaching and help with organisational tasks at the chair.

**Your Profile**

* Enrolled in a Master's programme in data science, economics, management, psychology, computer science, mathematics/statistics, or a related field
* Solid data analysis skills ideally in R or Python; experience with machine learning or NLP is a plus
* A keen interest in human decision making and in what data science and AI can reveal about it
* Very good written and spoken English
* An independent, reliable way of working
* Ideally, some knowledge of (behavioral) economics and the ambition to pursue a PhD

**We Offer**

* Ideal PhD preparation: hands-on experience of the full research cycle, from data to paper
* The chance to co-author a paper aimed at a top journal, depending on your contribution
* The option to write your Master's thesis within the project
* Close personal mentoring
* Access to an international research network – valuable for your next academic step
* Flexible hours that fit your studies, on campus in Berlin or remote, and room for your own ideas

**Interested?**

Want a head start on your PhD? Send your CV, transcript of records and a short cover letter on what excites you about the project via the button below to:

**ESCP Business School, Campus Berlin**  
Prof. Dr. Florian M. Artinger  
Chair of Data Science  
Heubnerweg 8-10, 14059 Berlin

https://escp.eu/berlin

**About ESCP Business School:** ESCP Business School is an international business school with campuses in six European cities. Founded in 1819, ESCP is the oldest business school in the world. To this day, the business school regularly ranks at the top of the Financial Times rankings. ESCP Berlin's academic focus is on entrepreneurship, sustainability and digitalisation.
