title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) KI-gestützte Software- und Plattformentwicklung
description: Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten. Was trägst Du bei? Du möchtest neben dem Studium einen Einblick in ein Entwicklungs- und Plattformteam gewinnen und herausfinden, wie KI sinnvoll für die Entwicklung in großen Organisationen eingesetzt werden kann? In unserem Team arbeitest du an der Weiterentwicklung von Anwendungen und Services im Bereich Softwareentwicklung und KI. Dabei kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und bekommst viele Gelegenheiten, Dich auch mit KI, DevOps und Cloud-Technologien zu beschäftigen. Hierfür suchen wir einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Braunschweig und einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Berlin. Bei uns entwickelst und pflegst Du Software- und Plattformkomponenten. Dabei arbeitest du hauptsächlich mit Rust oder Python, gegebenenfalls auch mit anderen Sprachen wie Go oder JavaScript. Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer Funktionen sowie bei der Behebung von Fehlern. Du lernst, Systeme zu entwickeln und KI-Agenten für die Softwareentwicklung zu orchestrieren. Du tauschst Dich im Team über technische Ansätze aus und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein. Je nach Interesse und Projektbedarf wirkst Du an KI-Anwendungen, automatisierten Entwicklungsabläufen oder Cloud-Themen mit. Was bringst Du mit? Du studierst Informatik oder Software-Engineering und kannst uns längerfristig unterstützen. Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Rust oder Python, zum Beispiel durch Projekte, Praktika oder Deine bisherige Arbeit. Alternativ kannst Du sehr gute Kenntnisse in einer anderen Programmiersprache vorweisen. Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit DevOps-Techniken, zum Beispiel CI/CD, Containerisierung oder Automatisierung gesammelt. Vorteilhaft sind zudem erste Erfahrungen mit den gängigen KI-Anwendungen, etwa mit Machine Learning, Sprachmodellen und KI-APIs. Des Weiteren sind Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, insbesondere im Open-Source-Bereich (z.B. Kubernetes, Docker, GitLab und Terraform/OpenTofu), ein Plus. Gute Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab. Was bieten wir Dir? title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth Management
description: DEMECAN – Wir kultivieren Lebensqualität DEMECAN, unser Name steht für Deutsches Medizinal-Cannabis. Unser Ziel ist es, die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen zu verbessern, indem ihnen der Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis in „Made in Germany“-Qualität ermöglicht wird. Im Mai 2019 erhielt DEMECAN als einziges unabhängiges deutsches Unternehmen den Zuschlag zur Produktion von medizinischem Cannabis in Deutschland. In der Nähe von Dresden haben wir das Zentrum für medizinisches Cannabis mit einem modernen Indoor-Gewächshaus aufgebaut. Dort wachsen und blühen derzeit unsere exklusiven Cannabispflanzen. Wir verstehen uns als Pionier und Experte im Bereich Cannabis. Leistung, Initiative und Verantwortung zeichnet unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und unser Team aus. Durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Feedback-Kultur hat jede:r im Team die Möglichkeit, unsere Entwicklung mitzugestalten und medizinisches Cannabis in Deutschland zu einer Erfolgsstory zu machen. Geh' mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere und bewirb Dich bei uns. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth Management. Was wir bieten: flexible Arbeitszeiten (mobiles Arbeiten möglich) einen abwechslungsreichen Job mit großen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten bei dem einzigen unabhängigen deutschen Hersteller von medizinischem Cannabis thematische und technische Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen ein kreativ-dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einem freundlichen und professionellen Team Benefits wie: Frisches Obst, kostenlose Getränke, hundefreundliches Büro, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und Möglichkeiten zur individuellen Weiterbildung Was du mitbringst: Du befindest dich vorzugsweise in sicher im Umgang mit Excel (Pivot, XVERWEIS, idealerweise Power Query) und PowerPoint Erste Erfahrungen mit Power BI oder SQL sind von Vorteil Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und analytisches Denkvermögen mit Du legst eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung an den Tag Ein diskreter Umgang mit vertraulichen Preis- und Konditionsdaten ist für dich selbstverständlich Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, ein gutes Zeitmanagement und eine klare, verbindliche Kommunikation Eine hohe Lernbereitschaft, eine Produktaufnahmen und -auslistungen, MHD und Staffelpreisen Du hältst die Sales-Forecast-Liste und die Chargenübersicht aktuell (Freigaben, Zuordnung Apotheke/Telemedizin, Preisranges) Du bereitest Sales Bridge, Spreads zwischen Apotheke und Telemedizin sowie KPI-Dashboards in Excel und Power BI vor Du stellst die Unterlagen für S&OP, Commercial Weekly und Commercial Review & Planning zusammen Du beobachtest Markt und Wettbewerb, zum Beispiel Preise und Sortimente auf Telemedizin-Plattformen sowie Listungen anderer Hersteller Du pflegst Produktstammdaten wie PZN-Liste, Produktnamen und Label-Claims in Abstimmung mit Portfoliomanagement und Qualitätskontrolle Du unterstützt bei Ad-hoc-Analysen zu Chargenperformance, Preiseffekten und Kundensegmenten Wenn Du mit uns Großes erreichen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und der Info, ab wann Du mit wie vielen Stunden bis voraussichtlich wann DEMECANNON werden willst.

title: Werkstudent:in Datenanalyse & Finanzprodukte (all genders)
description: Werde Teil unserer Mission bei Finanztip Du gehst Zahlen gerne auf den Grund und möchtest verstehen, was hinter Finanzprodukten steckt? Unterstütze unser Test & Analyse-Team bei Recherchen, Beispielrechnungen und der Prüfung von Daten. Damit hilfst Du uns dabei, Finanzthemen verständlich und nachvollziehbar aufzubereiten. Die Stelle ist vollständig remote möglich. Wenn Du im Raum Berlin wohnst, kannst Du aber natürlich auch gerne vor Ort in unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten. Das sind wir Finanztip ist kein gewöhnliches Unternehmen. Als Teil der gemeinnützigen Finanztip Stiftung haben wir eine klare Mission: Finanzen einfach machen. Dabei sind wir nicht nur Deutschlands führender Geldratgeber, sondern überzeugen auch als Arbeitgeber mit einer Kultur, in der Sinn und gesellschaftliche Verantwortung auf Ambition und Spitzenleistung treffen. Über 100 engagierte Talente gehören bereits zu unserem starken Team – und wir wachsen weiter! Starte mit echter Praxiserfahrung, entwickle neue Skills und wachse jeden Tag über Dich hinaus. In unseren modernen Offices in München und Berlin findest Du alles, was Du für produktives Arbeiten brauchst: ein offenes Team, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine exzellente technische Ausstattung. Und weil uns Deine Work-Study-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt, gestalten wir Deine Arbeitszeiten gemeinsam flexibel. Mit Wellpass kannst Du außerdem zahlreiche Sport- und Wellnessangebote nutzen – für den passenden Ausgleich neben Studium und Job. Das ist Deine Rolle Du recherchierst zu Finanzprodukten und Finanzthemen und arbeitest Dich in unterschiedliche Fragestellungen ein. Dein Interesse an Finanzen und Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe helfen Dir dabei, relevante Informationen zu erfassen und Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Mit Beispielrechnungen machst Du finanzielle Zusammenhänge nachvollziehbar. Dabei bringst Du Deinen mathematisch-naturwissenschaftlichen Hintergrund und Dein gutes Zahlenverständnis ein. Du erfasst Daten und dokumentierst Ergebnisse so, dass das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dafür nutzt Du Deine Erfahrung mit Excel und Deinen Blick für Details. Bei Qualitätskontrollen prüfst Du Daten und Berechnungen nach dem Vier-Augen-Prinzip auf Richtigkeit und Plausibilität. Deine analytischen Fähigkeiten helfen Dir, Unstimmigkeiten zu erkennen und ihnen auf den Grund zu gehen. Du bereitest Rechercheergebnisse und Analysen verständlich auf und bringst offene Fragen auf den Punkt. Dabei hilft Dir Dein Verständnis für Finanzthemen, auch komplexe Zusammenhänge nachvollziehbar darzustellen. Kurz & knapp – Damit kannst Du punkten: Du bist noch mindestens ein Jahr immatrikuliert und kannst uns 15–20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen. Ein mathematisch-naturwissenschaftliches Studium ist ein Plus - auch mit einem anderen Studienfach bist Du willkommen, wenn Dir der Umgang mit Zahlen liegt. Du denkst analytisch, interessierst Dich für Finanzthemen und möchtest Dein Wissen bei uns weiter ausbauen. Mit Excel und KI-Tools hast Du bereits gearbeitet; Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Deine Deutschkenntnisse liegen mindestens auf C1-Niveau. Das ist Dein Team Du wirst Teil unseres Test & Analyse-Teams , das dafür sorgt, dass sämtliche Tests und Analysen unserer Redaktion nach nachvollziehbaren Kriterien erfolgen. Je nach Projekt arbeitest Du mit unterschiedlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und wirst dabei von festen Ansprechpersonen begleitet und unterstützt. Gemeinsam schafft Ihr eine verlässliche Grundlage für fundierte Finanzentscheidungen. Du fühlst Dich angesprochen? Dann lass uns wissen, wer Du bist und warum Du unsere Mission bei Finanztip mitgestalten möchtest. Für uns zählt, welche Ideen Du mitbringst und was Dich antreibt – ganz gleich, woher Du kommst oder welche Geschichte Du mitbringst. Auf Deine Bewerbung freut sich Selina Eicher aus unserem People & Culture-Team. Wenn Du noch mehr über uns erfahren möchtest, wirf gerne einen Blick auf unsere Karriereseite.

Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization. We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact? Responsibilities Support enhancing the TeamViewer's presence in the partner ecosystem by integrating TeamViewer features and building new use cases in the AI space Ensure the quality of the delivered integrations from our development partners. Set up and run demo environments and create collaterals to support the greater Sales and Support organizations. Build expertise on web platforms like ServiceNow and Salesforce to help grow TeamViewer use cases on them. Support the Business Development team to operate and build the integrations of TeamViewer into third-party systems. Completed at least four semesters of university studies, with a preference for Master's students. Previous work experience or internship experience in a corporate environment is required. Excellent English communication skills. Practical experience in at least one of the following areas: web applications (e.g. CRMs, ticketing systems), admin activities (e.g. hosting a blog or managing a website/forum), or AI (experience building AI agents is a plus). Ability to work independently, e.g. by showing own initiative through university projects or preferably personal projects. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. Bei DRIVE Consulting unterstützt du führende Industrie- und Automotive-Unternehmen dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette zu lösen. Du arbeitest an spannenden Fragestellungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten und trägst dazu bei, gemeinsam mit deinem Team nachhaltige und wirkungsvolle Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln. Unsere Projekte bewegen sich in zentralen Zukunftsfeldern – von zukunftsweisenden Produktionsstrategien, modernen Produktionssystemen und Digital Manufacturing bis hin zur Entwicklung innovativer digitaler Produkte und Services. Wenn dich also Themen rund um Smart Factory, Robotics, Connected Car, Autonomous Driving und datengetriebene Lösungen mit Data & AI interessieren, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du unterstützt in dieser Rolle Projekte entlang des gesamten Projektverlaufs und gewinnst dabei früh Verantwortung. B. für vernetzte Funktionen oder neue Geschäftsmodelle Du wirkst an der Konkretisierung und Umsetzung dieser Konzepte mit, z. Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, steiler Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. With a Bachelor's degree in Digital Product Management and my ongoing Master's studies in International Business Management in Berlin, I am eager to contribute this hands-on, problem-solving mindset to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. A core focus of my work has been conversational AI, where I supported the rollout and continuous tuning of our AI voice bot across 9 markets, routing millions of calls and increasing answer rates from 65% to 85%. I also manage the knowledge architecture and retrieval datasets for an AI chatbot handling over 30,000 monthly inquiries, and built an internal bulk-review QA platform to streamline how agents evaluate model quality.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about DRIVE Consulting is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support DRIVE Consulting in this role.

title: PR & Communications Intern - German speaking for March 2027 (f/m/d)
description:
Berlin

Full-time

Intern / Student

  

**What you will do:**
---------------------

* General Support of the PR and Communications Team.
* Areas: Influencer Marketing, PR, Social Media, Sample & Seeding Logistics.
* Influencer Marketing: Support on providing the Aeyde influencer community with assets and all relevant brand information, Track and monitor press and influencer coverage and compile weekly and monthly reports.
* Social Media: Coordination of social media activities, Community management.
* PR & Communications: Respond to sample & asset requests from editors, monitor reporting, coordinate all sample loans for editorial photoshoots and influencer giftings, including packing and sending the collections with city-based and international couriers etc., liaise with our PR agencies to deliver assets and products on time, work with our PR sample & media monitoring tech tool on a daily basis.
* Event preparation: Organization of showrooms and press/influencer events.
* Support on market & digital talent research.
* General PR administrative tasks such as keeping PR tools up to date with all relevant information.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Currently enrolled as a student and looking for a 6 months compulsory internship as part of your university studies.
* Interested in pursuing a career in PR & Communications.
* Strong personal interest and first work experience in fashion, art and culture.
* Good project management skills.
* Well organized and good at keeping timelines.
* Flexible and hands-on.
* Proficient in Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs and macOS.
* Excellent communication skills in English and German.
* Legally authorized to take up employment in Germany.
* Start: March 2027.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* A bright and spacious design office in the heart of Berlin embodying our brand values and focusing on employee well-being.
* A unique chance to shape our company’s future and build a global brand, all within a motivating, international work environment with employees of 14+ nationalities.
* A high level of responsibility, creative freedom, and the opportunity to bring your originality, ideas, and independence to life.
* One farewell gift voucher, to be used on Aeyde footwear and accessories.
* Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, Berlin Public Transport pass or subsidized German class.
* 12 days of holidays within your 6 month internship.
* Regular team events include our Christmas and Summer Party as well as extraordinary monthly team lunches.

**About us**
------------

Aeyde is a Berlin-based footwear and accessories house founded in 2015. Our mission is to challenge preconceived notions of luxury and the fashion industry by focusing on transparent pricing, sustainable sourcing, slow consumption, and minimal design. We started as a digital-first, D2C brand and continue to apply this mindset today. As we strive to be at the forefront of fashion innovation we are looking for people that can help us shape the future. Working at Aeyde, you will become an integral part of an international fashion start-up with many opportunities for personal development and the chance to shape a fast-growing brand on an international level.

title: Revenue Enablement Specialist
description:
**At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.**

**Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.**

Moss is scaling fast, and our commercial team is growing with it. That means Revenue Enablement has more exciting projects to deliver in 2027. We are looking for a Revenue Enablement Specialist to join our Revenue Enablement Lead and turn that growth into consistent, repeatable results across our revenue teams.

This is a rare 0 to 1 opportunity. You will build onboarding, training programs and knowledge management, and see them used in the field. You will also help bring AI-enabled workflows into everyday selling.

Maybe you are an experienced enabler who wants something new and adventurous. Maybe you are a seller who wants to turn what works for you into something that helps a whole team win. Either way, you will have real room to build and make an impact. You will report to the Revenue Enablement Lead, sitting within RevOps function and who sets the strategy and KPIs. You will work with xDR and AE teams, and support other commercial teams as priorities change. You will partner with Sales, RevOps , Product, Automation and PMM, so enablement works in the field and its impact can be measured.

**Projects you will work on**
-----------------------------

* **Commercial onboarding:** Build and run onboarding that helps new hires ramp faster and sell with confidence.
* **xDR programmes:** Deliver enablement programmes for our xDR teams.
* **Product enablement:** Work with the Product enablement team on ad hoc projects, such as getting new features and launches into the field.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Build the Revenue Enablement foundation:** Build and run the core enablement system within the strategy set by the Lead. This includes sales playbooks, onboarding programmes, training cadence and manager-led coaching frameworks.
* **Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows:** Take existing AI initiatives (e.g. MEDDIC coaching, BDR Coach, knowledge retrieval systems) and make them part of how teams really work. Adoption is the goal.
* **Embed enablement into the operating rhythm:** Bring it into onboarding, weekly team meetings, deal reviews and pipeline management, with support from frontline managers.
* **Centralise knowledge and enablement tools:** Build on one source of truth for GTM content. Set up lightweight tools (call libraries, LMS pilots, structured workflows) with clear ownership, easy search and consistent use.
* **Track and improve revenue impact:** Track and report on the KPIs agreed with RevOps and the Lead (ramp time, win rate, ACV, forecast hygiene, MEDDIC completeness, workflow adoption). Run targeted pilots and improve programmes based on results.
* **Work independently:** Once scope is approved, you deliver from start to finish and manage your own stakeholders.

**About you**
-------------

* 3 to 5 years in enablement, RevOps, sales operations or a similar GTM role in high-growth B2B SaaS, or a seller with a strong record of coaching peers.
* You use AI tools well to work faster and help GTM teams adopt them.
* You can work alone once the goal and scope are clear.
* German language skills are a nice to have, not a requirement.

**Skills and attributes**
-------------------------

* **Builder:** You build from zero with clarity and discipline and create repeatable systems (MEDDIC, onboarding, coaching, governance).
* **Operator:** You are practical and focused on revenue outcomes. You turn frameworks into playbooks, rubrics, templates and training that teams use.
* **Data-driven:** You link enablement to measurable impact, run fast pilots and improve based on data.
* **Cross-functional connector:** You work with Sales, PMM, Product, CS and RevOps. You turn field feedback into GTM insights and respect who owns what.
* **AI and workflow enabler:** You are comfortable with AI tools and automation and know how to build them into GTM processes.
* **Systems thinker:** You design knowledge, tools and AI workflows that reduce friction and give people one trusted source of truth without heavy process.

**About Moss**

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's **what else to expect:**

* Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
* Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
* Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

*Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).*

***By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our*** ***Data Privacy Policy******.***

title: People Operations Manager
description:
Deltia is growing fast, and we need someone to own the operational backbone that makes that possible. As our People Operations Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our Talent & People Manager to scale our team from ~30 to 100+ people over the next two years. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of compliance, process design, and employee experience.

**What you'll own**

* **Employment & legal:** End-to-end management of employment contracts, work permits, and visa processes in Germany and internationally, including EOR arrangements
* **Payroll:** Running and overseeing monthly payroll, ensuring accuracy and compliance across entities
* **Benefits:** Managing our existing benefits stack and proactively identifying, proposing, and implementing new offerings as we scale
* **Team culture:** Planning and coordinating team events and off-sites, both locally and abroad
* **Office operations:** Acting as the point of contact for our coworking space and handling day-to-day operational needs
* **HR processes & compliance:** Designing, documenting, and improving people processes as we grow, with a strong eye on German labor law and cross-border compliance topics

**Room to grow**  
Depending on your interests and background, there's space to own more:

* **Onboarding & offboarding:** Design and iterate the full employee lifecycle experience as we scale
* **HRIS & tooling:** Own the evaluation and rollout of our HR system of record
* **People analytics:** Build lightweight reporting on headcount, attrition, and hiring velocity to support decision-making
* **Learning & development:** Lay the groundwork for how Deltia invests in its people as the team matures

**What we're looking for**

* 2-4 years in People Ops, HR, or a closely related role, ideally in a fast-growing startup
* Solid understanding of German employment law; experience with international hiring or EORs is a plus
* Structured, hands-on, and comfortable operating with limited oversight
* Fluent in English; German is a strong plus

Start ASAP in Berlin - Hybrid  
  
#LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

Compensation Range: $50K - $65K

title: (Associate) Product Manager - Customer Lifecycle (f/m/x)
description: About Lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As an Associate Product Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, you will support the engine which makes sure our already onboarded customers have a positive experience on lifecycle events like re-KYC, account termination and customer service. Furthermore, you will be responsible for making sure lemon.markets delivers on its ongoing regulatory commitments. Your remit also covers owning the tooling which our operations colleagues use every day and making sure these evolve in sync with evolving regulatory landscape as well as business growth. Reporting to the domain's Senior PM, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work cross-functionally at lemon.markets and regularly interface with stakeholders from varying functional backgrounds. To be successful in this role, you should be able to bring stakeholders on the same page and drive a coherent product strategy aimed at improving the efficiency of processes which kick-in during the lifecycle of a customer with lemon.markets while making sure lemon.markets adheres to its regulatory obligations. In this role you will: Own the roadmap for the problem space end-to-end - i.e. from problem framing through to release, adoption and iteration. Be embedded in a cross-functional team including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, and your colleagues in functions such as finance, risk and compliance. Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs. Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off tactical fixes. Interface regularly with your immediate customers and stakeholders to understand their pain points, capture feedback and use this information to shape your roadmap and product strategy. Track market and regulatory developments in your problem space, and bring the insights back to the team and introduce informed iterations of your product strategy. Write clearly and often - decision records, partner-facing specs, internal narratives. Writing is how decisions get made here. You’ll be successful in this role if: You have at least 1-2 years of product experience, including independently shipping complex products. You take ownership of outcomes, not just features. You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can define an unclear problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone to hand you a spec. You are comfortable working through legal text. You form your own preliminary view on a legal or regulatory question before discussing it with experts, and you know which questions to bring to them. You argue your position based on data and evidence, and you iterate when the evidence changes. You write clearly. Decisions, specs, and partner communication are a core part of this job, and you can make complex topics easy to follow on paper. You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and actively explore how far they can take your output. You are professionally fluent in English. However, German speakers would be preferred. How we take care of you: 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply. If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply. You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets

title: Founders Associate (Enterprise Product) (all genders)
description: Your Impact This is not a traditional FA role. You work directly with our CEO and focus fully on product. autarc isgrowing into the operating system for larger energy businesses: multi-location installers, companies with 50+ employees and utilities. They need deeper ERP functionality, permissions, integrations, migrations and reporting that hold up at scale. You drive this. Your role sits between a forward deployed engineer and the interface to our five product teams. You lead the migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and bring every insight from the field back to the right PM. You work as one team with enterprise sales and customer success, stay close to customers in shared WhatsApp groups and jump in hands-on whenever they need something. You also run sales calls with large ERP prospects yourself. Your goal: a product our customers truly love. Especially in the beginning, you are on the road every two weeks, spending several days at a time with customers across Germany to build out our ERP motion. The career path is clear: after 6 to 9 months, you move from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise. You already bring product management experience. What you get from us is the deep dive: how our product works, how we think, our strategy and our product philosophy, straight from our CEO and alongside our five PMs.Your responsibilities include: Lead migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and own them until the deadline Write tickets and coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales and CustomerSuccess Work hands-on with enterprise sales and customer success, on-site with customers every two weeks Bring field insights to all five product teams and shape the enterprise roadmap with the CEO and PMs Track the trades ERP and installer software market and sharpen how autarc positions itself to win Turn customer discovery into clear specs and decisions Build prototypes and internal tools with AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable or whatever works best) Own product KPIs, usage analysis and follow-through on launches What You Bring 1 to 3 years of product management experience, ideally at a startup or in B2B software You live and breathe product. You are curious and can't stop improving things Ambitious, high-drive and very sharp. You pick up complex topics fast and want to grow quickly You build things. You have vibe coded real tools or apps and can show us what you made AI-pilled: you use AI for everything and get excited by every new model and tool Strong analytical skills and comfortable with data, systems and enterprise complexity You earn trust across teams without formal authority, through what you know and what you deliver Confident in front of a room. You present to 40 to 50 people and know the product down to everydetail You love being on the road. Every other week at customers across Germany, with nights in hotels You want to work hard. We work long hours with high intensity. If work-life balance is your top priority right now, this role is not the right fit Berlin-based, 5 days a week in the office (Mitte) when you are not on the road Fluent in English and German Big plus: You know the trades (Handwerk). You have worked at or with an installer, know software fortradespeople, our market and our competitors. Nice to have: Experience with data migrations and coding skills (SQL, Python). What We Offer A clear career path: from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise after 6 to 9 months, learning our product strategy and philosophy directly from our CEO Real ownership: Drive your work from idea to impact. Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy. Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day. Hybrid work in Berlin-Mitte: 3 days together in our office near Weinbergspark, 2 from home. Need more flexibility? We'll find a way. Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor. Annual team retreat plus regular team events. Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket. When it gets late: Your dinner via Uber Eats and your taxi home are on us. Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership. Next steps If your application is successful, you will participate in the following: Culture fit call Build challenge: a short take-home where you prototype something real Final on-site interview with the CEO and the team About Us Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps. autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030. Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

description: Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform. Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services. Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say. Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English). Job Description We are expanding our Product organization and are looking for an impact-driven (Associate) Product Manager (m/f/x) to join our Onboarding and Client Data domain. In this role, you will help shape the foundations of the client’s relationship with Scalable. This includes seamless onboarding, keeping important client information up to date, managing statuses and blocks, and reliably handling key lifecycle events. Throughout the recruitment process, we will explore your strengths, technical skills, and interests to identify where you can have the greatest impact within the domain. Key responsibilities: Partner closely with software engineers, designers, operations, and domain experts to scope, build, and ship reliable client journeys and internal capabilities. Help make it simple and secure for clients to provide, review, and update essential personal information and declarations throughout their relationship with Scalable. Contribute to products and processes that ensure client data, statuses, and lifecycle events are accurately recorded, transparent, and handled with care. Conduct user research, analyse feedback and metrics, and write clear user stories and specifications to maintain a healthy, outcome-oriented product backlog. Work with legal, risk, compliance, and client service stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements into intuitive, scalable digital products. Track product and operational metrics after launch, identify opportunities for improvement, and continually optimise customer outcomes. Locations: Hybrid in Berlin or Munich Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Data, Mathematics, Engineering, or an equivalent field. Work Experience: Initial experience gained through relevant internships, working student positions, or entry-level roles in product management, consulting, operations, or a fast-growing startup—ideally within fintech, banking, or complex environments. Tools & Agile Frameworks: Hands-on experience with modern agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Figma) and familiar with user story creation and rapid prototyping. Communication & Stakeholders: Clear and concise communicator in English (written and verbal), capable of bridging technical, operational, and business discussions across engineers, stakeholders, and executives. Work Ethic & Execution: Solution-oriented and proactive, with strong ownership, attention to detail, high resilience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. title: Junior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Certificate Business
description: Zertificon Solutions – Software manufacturer since 2004. We are IT security specialists: Our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of Germany's 100 largest companies by revenue, along with hundreds of medium-sized businesses across various industries, already rely on our Z1 encryption solutions. We have ambitious plans and continue to grow steadily. Almost 140 employees are already working at our Berlin-Neukölln office. Join our professional, highly qualified team: Take on new challenges, share your knowledge, keep learning, and discover your potential! Your tasks As a Junior Product Owner , you will contribute to the further development of our solutions for managing digital certificates – a key foundation for secure and encrypted business communication. Working closely with our Head of Product Certificate Business , you will help shape software components and services for managing and searching digital certificates, integrating external Certificate Authorities (CAs), and automating certificate-related processes. You independently develop solution concepts for new and existing features, taking into account customer needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives. You collaborate with our UI/UX Designer to create user-friendly solutions and, when needed, develop smaller mockups yourself. You translate agreed solution concepts into actionable epics, tasks, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria for your development team. You take ownership of maintaining and preparing your development team's product backlog and prioritize requirements in coordination with the Head of Product. You plan and coordinate software releases, keeping track of timelines, dependencies, and potential risks. As the main point of contact for your development team, you clarify functional questions and coordinate collaboration with Product Management, Support, and other stakeholders. You analyze market trends and the competitive landscape, using your insights to identify opportunities for improving our products. Your profile At least one year of hands-on experience in Product Ownership, Requirements Engineering, or a comparable role, ideally in a B2B software environment. Basic knowledge of software development and agile methodologies. Ability to structure complex topics and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for developers. Good technical understanding and an interest in software architectures, interfaces, and system integrations. Interest in IT security, digital certificates, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) – prior knowledge in these areas is an advantage but not a requirement. Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented approach to work, combined with a strong willingness to learn. Ability to work independently, reliability, and enjoyment of collaborating with different teams. Excellent English skills (at least C1 level) and good German skills (at least B2 level). We offer Flexible hours and home office options Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking Subsidies for meals (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office Get-togethers: monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. title: Founders Associate (Enterprise Product)
description: Your Impact This is not a traditional FA role. You work directly with our CEO and focus fully on product. autarc isgrowing into the operating system for larger energy businesses: multi-location installers, companies with 50+ employees and utilities. They need deeper ERP functionality, permissions, integrations, migrations and reporting that hold up at scale. You drive this. Your role sits between a forward deployed engineer and the interface to our five product teams. You lead the migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and bring every insight from the field back to the right PM. You work as one team with enterprise sales and customer success, stay close to customers in shared WhatsApp groups and jump in hands-on whenever they need something. You also run sales calls with large ERP prospects yourself. Your goal: a product our customers truly love. Especially in the beginning, you are on the road every two weeks, spending several days at a time with customers across Germany to build out our ERP motion. The career path is clear: after 6 to 9 months, you move from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise. You already bring product management experience. What you get from us is the deep dive: how our product works, how we think, our strategy and our product philosophy, straight from our CEO and alongside our five PMs.Your responsibilities include: Lead migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and own them until the deadline Write tickets and coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales and CustomerSuccess Work hands-on with enterprise sales and customer success, on-site with customers every two weeks Bring field insights to all five product teams and shape the enterprise roadmap with the CEO and PMs Track the trades ERP and installer software market and sharpen how autarc positions itself to win Turn customer discovery into clear specs and decisions Build prototypes and internal tools with AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable or whatever works best) Own product KPIs, usage analysis and follow-through on launches What You Bring 1 to 3 years of product management experience, ideally at a startup or in B2B software You live and breathe product. You are curious and can't stop improving things Ambitious, high-drive and very sharp. You pick up complex topics fast and want to grow quickly You build things. You have vibe coded real tools or apps and can show us what you made AI-pilled: you use AI for everything and get excited by every new model and tool Strong analytical skills and comfortable with data, systems and enterprise complexity You earn trust across teams without formal authority, through what you know and what you deliver Confident in front of a room. You present to 40 to 50 people and know the product down to everydetail You love being on the road. Every other week at customers across Germany, with nights in hotels You want to work hard. We work long hours with high intensity. If work-life balance is your top priority right now, this role is not the right fit Berlin-based, 5 days a week in the office (Mitte) when you are not on the road Fluent in English and German Big plus: You know the trades (Handwerk). You have worked at or with an installer, know software fortradespeople, our market and our competitors. Nice to have: Experience with data migrations and coding skills (SQL, Python). What We Offer A clear career path: from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise after 6 to 9 months, learning our product strategy and philosophy directly from our CEO Real ownership: Drive your work from idea to impact. Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy. Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day. Hybrid work in Berlin-Mitte: 3 days together in our office near Weinbergspark, 2 from home. Need more flexibility? We'll find a way. Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor. Annual team retreat plus regular team events. Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket. When it gets late: Your dinner via Uber Eats and your taxi home are on us. Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership. Next steps If your application is successful, you will participate in the following: Culture fit call Build challenge: a short take-home where you prototype something real Final on-site interview with the CEO and the team About Us Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps. autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030. Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Trainee im Junior Expert Programme – Backoffice Systems & Process Design (w/m/d)
description: Wir sind ein moderner Arbeitgeber mit attraktiven Arbeitsplätzen, zahlreichen Sozialleistungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Vielem mehr. Wenn Du kurz vor Deinem Abschluss stehst und **zum 1. Januar, 1. April oder zum 1. Oktober 2027** loslegen kannst, werde Junior Expert bei der ING. In unserem COO-Bereich kommen Banking-Prozesse, Daten, künstliche Intelligenz und agile Produktentwicklung zusammen: Hier entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams die Systeme, Prozesse und digitalen Lösungen weiter, die Banking für 10 Millionen Kund\*innen einfach, schnell und zuverlässig machen. An der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Customer Experience stellst Du Dich Problemen, analysierst Anforderungen, entwickelst Lösungen und setzt diese um. Dabei bist Du nicht nur Beobachter\*in, sondern übernimmst früh selbst Verantwortung. Mit Blick auf die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette erkennst Du komplexe Zusammenhänge im Privat- und Business-Banking, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und entwickelst konkrete, digitale Lösungsansätze für unsere Service- und Operations-Prozesse. Du bringst innovative Verbesserungen voran, indem Du fachliche Herausforderungen in technische Konzepte übersetzt, gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Prototypen entwickelst und neue AI-Lösungen sowie intelligente Assistenten auf Herz und Nieren testest. Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Im Netzwerk der Graduates tauschst Du Dich aus, teilst Erfahrungen und knüpfst wertvolle Kontakte. You will support the product backlog management and ensure that our products meet customer needs and business objectives. This is an exciting role where you will build and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape and industry trends. If you care about delivering products that customers love, enjoy working with different cultures, and meeting people from around the world, this position is a great opportunity for you. Join our team at our Product Hubs in Berlin , London, or Milan, or work from another country where Awin has an office. What you'll be responsible for: In this role, you will collaborate with product managers to manage the backlog. You will liaise between internal and external engineers, the UX team, and stakeholders to ensure clear communication of product requirements. You will monitor product performance metrics and generate reports to support data-driven decision making. You will partner with customer-facing teams to gather customer feedback and insights, and use that feedback to inform product development decisions You will identify opportunities with product peers to further add value to our plugins and various platform integrations You will work with the Product Marketing team to communicate releases and drive adoption of existing and new products You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce, customer-data platform landscape, and industry trends to inform product strategy for platform integrations Your Skills You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience. You have first experience or curiosity about working in product development You have experience or high-level understanding of Ecommerce or similar platforms You are comfortable with web technologies You are data driven and possess analytical and problem-solving skills You are comfortable in communicating with multiple stakeholders You are self-motivated, organised, capable of prioritising work and focusing on important tasks Our Offer Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance. Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home. description: Die e.distherm Energielösungen GmbH , ein 100%iges Tochterunternehmen der E.DIS AG und Teil der E.ON-Gruppe, ist darauf spezialisiert, individuelle, nachhaltige und klimaschonende Energielösungen für die Wohnungswirtschaft, für Kommunen sowie für Gewerbe- und Industriebetriebe zu entwickeln und zu betreiben. Das Unternehmen versorgt mehr als 1.000 Kunden insbesondere rund um die Metropolregion Berlin – Brandenburg zuverlässig mit Wärme, Kälte und Strom. Dazu zählen unter anderem der Hauptstadtflughafen BER sowie namhafte Automobilhersteller und -zulieferer im Industriepark in Ludwigsfelde. Eine Aufgabe, die herausfordert Du begleitest die Migration von Stammdaten aus dem bestehenden Datenbanksystem in das neue Microsoft Dynamics Field Service System. Gemeinsam mit dem Technischen Betrieb und dem Digitalisierungsteam entwickelst du Auswertungen und Tools, um die Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der migrierten Daten zu prüfen. Du bereitest Analysen und Abstimmungstermine eigenverantwortlich sowie im Team vor, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und verfolgst vereinbarte Maßnahmen nach. Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Organisation und Umsetzung der Stammdatenübertragung und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Betriebs- und Digitalisierungsteam zusammen. Gemeinsam mit dem Digitalisierungsteam entwickelst du das Microsoft Dynamics Field Service System kontinuierlich weiter, nimmst Anforderungen aus dem operativen Betrieb auf und wirkst bei der Einführung neuer Funktionen mit. Du unterstützt das Betriebsteam beim Monitoring technischer Anlagen sowie bei der Pflege und Auswertung von Störungs- und Betriebsdaten. Dabei erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Digitalisierung technischer Prozesse und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Service- und Datenmanagementsysteme. Ein Umfeld, das begeistert Du studierst aktuell Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationstechnik oder einen vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang. Auch wenn dein Schwerpunkt nicht direkt in der Informatik liegt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität mitbringst. Idealerweise hast du bis zum Abschluss deines Studiums noch mindestens vier Semester vor dir und möchtest uns langfristig in einem spannenden Migrationsprojekt unterstützen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein. Du hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit anderen Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen voranzutreiben. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Datenbanken, Datenstrukturen oder der Analyse von Datenqualität sind von Vorteil. Erfahrungen mit Microsoft Dynamics sind wünschenswert, aber kein Muss. Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis und interessierst dich für digitale Prozesse und Systeme. Du kommunizierst sicher in deutscher Sprache (mindestens C2-Niveau oder muttersprachliche Kenntnisse). Die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit vor Ort in Schönefeld ist für dich gut mit deinem Studienalltag vereinbar. Gleichzeitig profitierst du von der Möglichkeit, teilweise mobil zu arbeiten. Ein Umfeld, das begeistert Eine nachweislich hohe Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit: Zertifizierter Top Arbeitgeber seit 2022 (Kununu Score 4,3/5 Sterne & 97% Mitarbeiterweiterempfehlung). Eine Aufgabe voller Spannung, bei der wir gemeinsam an intelligenten Energienetzen und innovativen Energielösungen arbeiten. Einen flexiblen Anschluss für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance, z. B. durch flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Ein elektrisierendes Angebot an Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten wie z. B. Seminare, Workshops und Talentprogramme. Eine sichere Versorgung mit einer attraktiven Vergütung sowie vielen Zusatzleistungen, u. a. Gesundheitsangebote und betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein starkes Netzwerk, denn als Teil des E.ON Konzerns fördern wir die Zusammenarbeit über Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg und bieten vielfältige Perspektivwechsel. Werde Teil unseres Netzwerks! Die Integration von Menschen mit Behinderung entspricht unserem Selbstverständnis und wir begrüßen daher deren Bewerbung. cover_letter_paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Werkstudent Datenbankmigration (MS Dynamics Field Service) (m/w/d) role at E.DIS. Through my experience helping scale conversational AI tools, optimizing operational workflows, and building data-driven internal products at Auto1 Group, I have learned that the greatest value comes from combining analytical rigor with practical builder execution. With a Bachelor's degree in Digital Product Management and my ongoing Master's studies in International Business Management in Berlin, I am eager to contribute this hands-on, problem-solving mindset to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. A core focus of my work has been conversational AI, where I supported the rollout and continuous tuning of our AI voice bot across 9 markets, routing millions of calls and increasing answer rates from 65% to 85%. I also manage the knowledge architecture and retrieval datasets for an AI chatbot handling over 30,000 monthly inquiries, and built an internal bulk-review QA platform to streamline how agents evaluate model quality.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about E.DIS is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support E.DIS in this role.

title: City Manager
description:
Key Objectives of the Role

Yugo is the trusted name for student housing, globally. Every day we connect young people to opportunities and students to amazing spaces. Here at Yugo, we like to do things differently. It's about people, planet, and passion.

Our City Managers are in charge of our spaces within an assigned city location. This position has both an operational and strategic focus, they are #Futureshapers who want to positively influence and shape the lives of others students and Yugoers. They are responsible of the smooth running of our spaces and they oversee the day-to-day management as well as setting the future direction for the area.

Working closely with Assistant Residence Managers, the City Manager will ensure their assigned portfolio are safe and secure spaces that meet the established operational, financial and business-related targets. They will take overall responsibility for multiple assets in championing and executing strategies relating to property management operations, implementing agreed policies, and procedures and practices, whilst also actively driving improvement and operational excellence.

It’s a big job! Ensuring that our services are consistent and that we provide the best experience for students to live their best lives and financial performance for our investors.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Asset Management**

a. Manage and monitor appropriate health and safety compliance across the area, promoting a risk-free environment; drive a positive health and safety culture.

b. Oversee and support regulatory and compliance issues, as well as managing the financial performance of all spaces within the area.

c. Lead continuous improvement and provide value added initiatives across the area.

d. Take responsibility for asset mobilisation of any new residences in the location- to include the set-up of operational costings, people structures, standard operating procedures, recruitment of the teams and coordinating a meaningful onboarding experience in readiness of practical completion.

e. Provide and manage an escalation matrix in the event of an emergency, liaising with any press and responding to investors as appropriate.

f. Work with a wider operations team to drive consistent performance across the portfolio.

g. Use your upbeat, **open** minded and outgoing personality to lead, mentor and guide the team to ensure that the student space is running smoothly and new ideas are being welcomed.

h. Be Real. Take pride in what you do and own it. Ensuring high standards of all spaces under your management.

2. **Deliver on Income Targets**

a. Take a commercial approach to managing the residences whilst actively seeking ways to maximise revenue, including summer occupancy and alternative use strategy, and to identify ways to drive greater efficiency and reduce the cost per bed.

b. Be accountable for the delivery of all KPIs of the spaces under your responsibility, including the delivery of income targets in accordance with sales process and standards; regularly monitor performance and take action where necessary.

c. Lead on the annual budget setting process and the budget reforecast for the residences in conjunction with the Assistant Residence Managers.

d. Approve invoices from vendors, contractors and service providers for payment, escalating any issues to the finance team as appropriate.

e. Maintain and develop relationships with key players at the local universities, education organizations and any other key stakeholders–in order to build stronger referral networks and potentially secure future business.

f. Work alongside the Sales and Marketing team to develop and execute strategies to enhance sales opportunities and performance within the area, ensuring that all properties have an occupancy level in line with the business plan, taking action where necessary including escalating any issues to the Operations Manager.

**Key Performance Indicators – Revenue**

* NOI target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space
* GOI target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space
* Debt target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space

**3. Student Experience**

a. Ensure that our students live their best life, so that we exceed their expectations and they re-book or refer us to others.

b. Act as an inspirational lead to the team by exceeding expectations for our residents; oversee the delivery of outstanding customer service by others

c. Inspire the team to initiate and lead on resident involvement and social events.

d. Be proactive in striving for continuous improvement to our service offering, ensuring positive feedback from our residents, strong social media presence, and minimal complaints.

e. Be True. Acting responsible towards others and the planet. Making sure to deliver on our three Pillars to ensure our students live their best life. YugoEco, YuPro and YuGrow..

**4. Our Team of Yugoers**

a. Lead and inspire the operational teams to perform across the spaces of your responsibility. Be Bold. Ensuring that boundaries are there to be challenged and encourage a bias for action attitude across the teams.

b. To be both part of the Senior Operations team and a support to local residence-based teams.

c. Line manages and act as a coach to the General and Residence Managers within the area, including conducting regular one-to-one’s, appraisals, creating development plans and any other forms of people management that are required.

d. Act as a role model by consistently demonstrating the GSA values.

e. Liaise with student groups and University partners in order to drive the business forward and to manage and maintain productive ongoing relationships.

f. Work closely with any support function as required to drive collaborative working, operational performance and to maximise revenue.

g. Build strong relationships with key support functions including Sales, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Systems, HR and Finance.

Key Performance Indicators – People

* Attrition

* + HRIS – monthly across Spaces
* Leavers within 90 days across spaces as per target
* Engagement

* Participation rate goal in annual engagement survey
* Survey Engagement score from annual survey
* Performance Reviews Completion – annually as per target

**5. What else?**

This job description serves as a guideline; this list of responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive and other requests commensurate with the role may be made of you from time-to-time. This role also requires a degree of flexibility in terms of days and hours worked. There may be occasional weekend and evening work, particularly during the busy summer months.

Key Skills & Capabilities

* **Excellent communicator.** Articulates and reinforce our brand story, values and behaviors with your teams. With great skills in both written and oral English & Spanish.
* **Passion**– Shows interest in, anticipates, and responds timely to stakeholder needs. Strives to consistently meet service standards.
* **Managing resources** – Plans, coordinates and manages internal and external resources to accomplish role responsibilities and/or assigned tasks.
* **Interpersonal skills**–Gives timely feedback and provides coaching to the teams to help them develop and grow to their maximum potential. Understands and recognizes the value of other points of view and ways of doing things.
* **Administrative Skills** – Computer literate with strong application of Microsoft programs Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Demonstrable knowledge and experience in producing sound technical reports. Understands and recognises the value of other points of view and ways of doing things.

Experience and Knowledge

**Essential:**

a. Relevant experience managing teams (e.g. hospitality, residence-based, student accommodation)

b. Proven financial responsibility including managing forecasts, budgets and P&Ls.

c. Experience delivering projects on time and to a high standard.

d. Experience developing a continuous improvement culture and to have an impact on the way things are done.

e. Resilience and adaptability, as well as a great cultural diversity awareness.

f. Qualification and/or willingness to undertake training for Carbon Literacy.

**Desirable:**

a. Experience in other markets and areas

b. Relevant Business or Hospitality degree

c. Competency in other languages

d. Experience of working with diversity and in different markets

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
description:
**Location**: 100% remote (EMEA)

**Classification**: Full-time

**Pay Range**: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

### **What you’ll work on****:**

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

### **What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:**

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

* You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.
* We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.
* We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.
* One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.
* Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:
  + 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:
* 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)
* 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager
* 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations
* Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)
* Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization
* Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

### **What makes you stand out:**

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

### **Responsibilities**

* Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability
* Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work
* Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.
* Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc
* Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

### **Our hiring process**

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

* **Application and CV Review** - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.
* **Initial Technical Screen** (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.
* **Behavioral Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.
* **1st Technical Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.
* **Scenario-based Technical Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.
* **Leadership Interview** (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.
* **Reference check** - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.
* **Offer & background check** - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.
